test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Against whom was the Battle of Plassey (1757) fought by the English Company led by Robert Clive?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siraj Ud Daulah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** East India Company** force led by** Robert Clive** and** Siraj-Ud-Daulah**, the **Nawab of Bengal**, engaged in a battle on** June 23, 1757, at Plassey**, in response to the East India Company's** misuse of trade privileges**, which infuriated the Nawab.
 
• **Mir Jafar, the chief commander** of Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah,** defected**, which allowed for the victory of East India Company.
 
• With Clive's triumph, the British rose to become India's dominant economic and military force after **capturing Calcutta**.
 
• The **Battle of Plassey** took place at a site called** Palashi (or Plassey),** on the banks of the Hooghly River, about 150 kilometres north of Calcutta and south of Murshidabad, which was then the capital of Bengal Subah.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The title of the kings who ruled the state of** Awadh in north India** during the **18th and 19th centuries **was** "Nawab of Awadh"** or **"Nawab of Oudh"**.
 
• **First Nawab of Bengal, Murshid Quli Khan** reigned from **1717 to 1727 **and was also known as **Zamin Ali Quli**. He was born as hindu and was originally called, **Surya Narayan Mishra**.
